notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flesh Duplicate.
description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Flesh Duplicate's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Flesh Duplicate leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
